name: engram-mdb
description: Markdown-native agent memory and knowledge database

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/*.test.js dist/tests/search/*.test.js dist/tests/security/*.test.js dist/tests/memory/capture.test.js dist/tests/memory/remote-spool.test.js dist/tests/memory/physical-merge.test.js dist/tests/memory/recall.test.js dist/tests/profile/insights.test.js dist/tests/memory/handoff.test.js dist/tests/dream/*.test.js dist/tests/adaptive/*.test.js dist/tests/wiki/compile.test.js dist/tests/query/operators.test.js dist/tests/query/vault.test.js dist/tests/query/parity.test.js dist/tests/query/security.test.js dist/tests/query/recovery.test.js dist/tests/query/fuzz.test.js dist/tests/unix/parity.test.js dist/tests/unix/features.test.js dist/tests/unix/sandbox.test.js

scripts.test:reliability: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/acid/*.test.js dist/tests/isolation/*.test.js dist/tests/fuzz/*.test.js dist/tests/backups/*.test.js
